import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Conjecture 4.13

by Ya. G. Berkovich

Prove that every finite non-abelian $p$-group admits an automorphism of order $p$
which is not an inner one.

By a theorem of Gaschütz, every finite $p$-group of order greater than $p$ has a
non-inner automorphism of $p$-power order. The problem asks for a non-inner
automorphism of order exactly $p$. The non-abelian hypothesis is needed: the
cyclic group of order $p$ has no automorphism of order $p$.

*Reference:* [The Kourovka Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/1401.0300v46)
-/

namespace Kourovka.«4.13»

/--
Every finite non-abelian $p$-group $G$ admits an automorphism of order $p$ which is
not an inner one, i.e. there is $\varphi \in \operatorname{Aut}(G)$ with
$|\varphi| = p$ and $\varphi \notin \operatorname{Inn}(G)$.

The inner automorphisms are the conjugation maps $h \mapsto g h g^{-1}$, i.e. the
range of `MulAut.conj`.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 20]
theorem kourovka.«4.13» :
    ∀ (p : ℕ) (G : Type) [Group G] [Finite G], p.Prime → IsPGroup p G →
      ¬ IsMulCommutative G →
      ∃ φ : MulAut G, orderOf φ = p ∧ φ ∉ (MulAut.conj : G →* MulAut G).range := by
  sorry

end Kourovka.«4.13»
attempts.decomposition_objections: None; the single-slot decomposition matches the statement.
modeling_decisions: Inner automorphisms are modeled as the range of `MulAut.conj : G →* MulAut G` (the conjugation maps h ↦ g h g⁻¹); 'not an inner one' is `φ ∉ MulAut.conj.range`.

'Automorphism of order p' is `orderOf φ = p` in the group `MulAut G`; since G is finite, `MulAut G` is finite and `orderOf` is the genuine order (never the default 0), so this demands order exactly p rather than p-power order.
'p-group' is `IsPGroup p G` together with `Finite G` and `p.Prime`; for finite G this is equivalent to |G| being a power of p.
'Non-abelian' is `¬ IsMulCommutative G` (Mathlib's class stating ∀ a b, a * b = b * a).
The statement is imperative ('Prove that …'), not a yes/no question, so it is stated as a plain theorem with `sorry`, without `answer(sorry)`, per CONTRIBUTING.md.
G is quantified over `Type` (not `Type*`) following the other Kourovka files.

All primitives (IsPGroup, MulAut, MulAut.conj, orderOf, IsMulCommutative) exist in Mathlib.
